"""Check real MainUI admission after a home-only committed save."""
import json
import logging
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from time import monotonic

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
os.environ['QT_QPA_PLATFORM'] = 'offscreen'
from check_home_profile_interruption import open_home, close_home, care, expected_care
from PySide6.QtCore import QCoreApplication, QEvent
from PySide6.QtGui import QImage, QColor
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from frontengine.show.pet.pet_profile_session import PetProfileSession
from frontengine.utils.pet_game import snapshot
from frontengine.utils.pet_game.catalog import builtin_catalog

app = QApplication([])
app.setQuitOnLastWindowClosed(False)
result = {}
previous = Path.cwd()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='front-crash-admission-') as name:
    directory = Path(name)
    os.chdir(directory)
    try:
        owner, home = open_home(directory)
        owner.settings.update(language='English', smart_pause=False,
                              pet_home_running=False, pet_home_on_desktop=False)
        identifier = owner.profiles().create('Admission check')['id']
        home.create_home('screen', 0, 900, 40, seed=5, furnish=True, home='a' * 32)
        assert home.adopt(identifier) == 'accepted'
        assert home.save_now()
        close_home(owner, home)
        worker = ROOT / '.audit/check_home_profile_interruption.py'
        process = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, str(worker), 'worker', name, '0'],
                                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                                   creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
        stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=240)
        assert process.returncode == 73, (process.returncode, stdout, stderr)
        expected = snapshot.from_dict(json.loads((directory / 'expected.json').read_bytes()), builtin_catalog())
        from frontengine.ui import main_ui
        from frontengine.ui.page.pet_game import home_page
        from frontengine.utils.session_lock import session_lock
        from frontengine.utils.multi_language.retranslate import translate
        main_ui.CriticalExit.init_critical_exit = lambda self: None
        main_ui.HotkeyService.start = lambda self: False
        main_ui.AppProfileService.start = lambda self: None
        main_ui.ShareWatchService.start = lambda self: None
        home_page.workshop_pack_roots = lambda: []
        session_lock.is_session_locked = lambda: False
        window = main_ui.FrontEngineMainUI(show_system_tray_ray=False, redirect_output=False)
        try:
            service = window.pet_home_ui.service
            assert service.world.home == expected.home
            assert expected_care(service.world.residents[identifier]) == expected_care(expected.residents[identifier])
            assert identifier in service.sessions
            assert PetProfileSession.active(service.profiles, identifier) is service.sessions[identifier]
            page = window.pet_setting_ui
            image = QImage(32, 32, QImage.Format.Format_ARGB32)
            image.fill(QColor('blue'))
            path = directory / 'probe.png'
            assert image.save(str(path))
            page.pet_image_path = str(path)
            page.profile_controls.refresh()
            index = page.profile_controls.selector.findData(identifier)
            assert index >= 0
            page.profile_controls.selector.setCurrentIndex(index)
            page._spawn_pet()
            assert not page.pet_list
            assert page.profile_controls.status.text() == translate('pet_profile_active')
            result['normal_start_rejects_duplicate_pet'] = True
            result['rejection_message'] = page.profile_controls.status.text()
            assert service.release(identifier) == 'accepted'
            assert care(service.profiles.get(identifier)) == expected_care(expected.residents[identifier])
            standalone = PetProfileSession(None, identifier, service.profiles)
            standalone.companion.energy = 84
            standalone.companion.hunger.value = 85
            standalone.companion.mood.value = 86
            standalone.companion.growth.affection = 87
            assert standalone.close()
            standalone.deleteLater()
            assert service.adopt(identifier) == 'accepted'
            assert expected_care(service.world.residents[identifier]) == dict(energy=84, fullness=85, mood=86, affection=87)
            assert service.save_now()
            result['release_mirrors_committed_home_care'] = True
            result['readoption_preserves_standalone_care'] = True
        finally:
            window.request_shutdown()
            deadline = monotonic() + 90
            while not window.lifetime.closed and monotonic() < deadline:
                QCoreApplication.sendPostedEvents(None, QEvent.Type.DeferredDelete)
                app.processEvents()
            assert window.lifetime.closed, (window.lifetime.state, window.lifetime.error)
            window.deleteLater()
            QCoreApplication.sendPostedEvents(None, QEvent.Type.DeferredDelete)
        logging.shutdown()
    finally:
        os.chdir(previous)
result['temporary_directory_removed'] = True
(ROOT / '.audit/crash-restart-admission-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
